Overview

About Wallpaper

Wallpaper changes the mood of a room in a day. From soft botanicals to bold patterns, our premium finishes turn a plain wall into a feature that suits your style.

Transform your walls with beautiful designs and premium finishes, from soft botanicals to bold patterns.

02

Types & quality

Choose the right Wallpaper

Swatches are digital renderings that show the look of each type. The real product's colour and finish can vary a little.

Bedrooms

Vinyl botanical

Vinyl-coated paper with a printed leaf pattern. Wipes clean and handles humidity better than plain paper.

Best for: Bedrooms, hallways

Living rooms

Non-woven geometric

A paper and fibre blend that is easy to hang and peels off in one piece.

Best for: Living rooms, offices

Feature walls

Grasscloth-style texture

A woven look that adds depth and warmth. Real grasscloth needs careful handling; vinyl versions are easier to clean.

Best for: Feature walls, lounges

Dining rooms

Striped embossed paper

Subtle tone-on-tone stripes with raised texture, which makes ceilings look taller.

Best for: Dining rooms, hotel rooms

07

Material guide

Know your material

What it is

Wallpaper is printed or embossed paper, vinyl or non-woven material applied to walls with paste.

How it is made

Patterns are printed on rolls, then finished with a coating or texture.

Installation tip

Prepare and prime the wall, then paste and hang each drop, matching the pattern as you go.

Strengths

  • Changes the mood of a room fast
  • Hides minor wall texture
  • Many patterns and colours

Good to know

  • Walls must be smooth, dry and primed
  • Pattern matching adds some waste
08

FAQ

Common questions

Is wallpaper washable?

Vinyl and coated papers can be wiped clean. Check the washability rating of each design.

How much do I need?

Measure wall height and width and allow for the pattern repeat. We can help you calculate.
